facts.fact: Dean of Assessment Mathilde Brodier 本人就是分派给他们考场的两名 examiner 之一
facts.anchor: The Dean of Assessment herself must have been one of their two assigned examiners.

facts.fact: Brodier 说 proctor geas 四天后失效，届时所有人才能自由陈述
facts.anchor: the geas will wear off in four days’ time, and we will all be able to speak freely then

facts.fact: 警员 Quentin 提出 Ysabel 是自杀：可能独自练习治疗术导致 burnout，或从廊台跳下
facts.anchor: She was either practising on her own and burned out

facts.fact: Brodier 是 Ysabel 的研究导师，其项目是治疗 echo headaches 的新方法，理论上很有前景
facts.anchor: It was a new approach for echo headaches. Very promising in the theory.

facts.fact: 按 Academie 规矩，学者与治疗师的遗体归 Academie 所有并用于解剖课；Brodier 说会把她冷冻在 bodykeeping room 到新学年
facts.anchor: became the property of the Academie and were used for anatomy classes

facts.fact: Clement 坚持 Ysabel 不会自杀，质问是否就这样结案，但警员已不再听
facts.anchor: “Wait. Is that it? No more investigation? Ysabel didn’t kill herself.”

facts.fact: Alys 说 Dux Scolaris 现在大概轮到 Estiene，众人由此意识到 Estiene 可能为排名上升一位而杀 Ysabel
facts.anchor: Oh. They meant Estiene might have killed Ysabel to climb one spot higher in the rankings.

facts.fact: 信使把信交给 Jehan，Jehan 展示信末那个自信圈绕的署名——Ysabel Caudotte，信中给出 hare fever 的理想治疗方案并邀他当天午餐
facts.anchor: Jehan lifted the letter to show them all the confidently looping name at the bottom.
